title: RNSpectraX (Spectral Plotter and Analytics Suite)
description:
RNSpectraX is a browser-based suite for processing, analysing and plotting Raman/SERS spectra and general XY data. It provides despiking, baseline correction (ModPoly, rubber band, rolling ball, asymmetric least squares), smoothing, normalisation, shift calibration and derivative spectra; group statistics; peak detection and band assignment; reference-library identification; band fitting, band ratios with significance tests, PCA and difference spectra; least-squares curve fitting; and resonance tracking with calibration, LOD and LOQ for SPR/LSPR sensing. All calculations run locally in the browser.
